title: indigo_agent_scheduler: list only planned runs in the night plan, show UNPLANNED tasks and a reason column in the task list, report the twilight limit as "sun above -N°"
description:
AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN appends, after the planned runs, Alert items for tasks that have no run before the end of the night (state NOT TONIGHT with reason disabled / script error / no time left tonight / an altitude or time-window reason, or UNREACHABLE with the altitude message), plus a '- | - | - | - | NOT TONIGHT | no night at the night limit within a day, the night hooks do not run' line (update_plan() in indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler.c, the loop after 'tasks without a run before the end of the night follow with the reason'). The owner reports this as a bug: the plan must show only what will run.

Expected: AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN contains only the planned runs (tasks and hooks, running entry Busy, others Idle). Tasks that do not run tonight, UNREACHABLE tasks and the no-night note are not listed. Keep the unreachable message (told once) and REASON behaviour unchanged. Update indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md (around line 775, the hook note near line 549, the test list near line 984, and SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md line 127 example) and the integration tests in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c that assert NOT TONIGHT / UNREACHABLE plan items, so they check absence from the plan and verify the unreachable state through its message/task state instead. Bump the agent version. Update PROPERTIES.md only if its plan description mentions these items.

outcome.summary:
Production code, docs and the deterministic new tests are correct; two test defects need fixing.

Verified OK: update_plan() (indigo_agent_scheduler.c:3140-3172) lists only planned runs and recomputes unplanned/unplanned_reason for every slot on each plan, republishing the task list only on change. is_unplanned() (548) also checks enabled/script error/unreachable/RUNNING/terminal at display time, so the flag cannot show stale after enable/disable, start of a run, finish, a hook assignment or an edit. create_task/remove_task memset the slot (1268, 1293), so reused slots and loaded configs start clear. Every row has 7 columns, only UNPLANNED/UNREACHABLE fill the reason, hooks give '-', UNPLANNED light is Idle. Twilight strings are 'sun above -6°/-12°/-18°' (indigo_agent_scheduler_sky.c:175) and are covered in unit tests. Version bumped 0x0300002D->2E. SCHEDULER.md, SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md, INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md and PROPERTIES.md are updated and no old text is left; anchors resolve. Python consumers: run_scheduler_simulators.py wait_task matches the substring ' | STATE | ', run_scheduler_two_servers.py task_state reads columns[1], and both history parsers (len==6) read AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY, which keeps 6 columns, so none breaks on the 7th column. tools/scheduler_sandbox.py only prints labels. make -C indigo_test test-agent-scheduler: 200 run, 200 passed (21:12 UTC).

Defects:
1. indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c:1350 (urgent_waits_for_eligibility) still requires exactly WAITING for 'Later', an urgent task whose @window opens up to 60 min ahead, at the default site 48.15N/17.11E with the real clock. The plan ends at the next sunrise (indigo_scheduler_night_end). If the window opens after that sunrise, indigo_scheduler_points_next returns 0 with 'window not open yet', so the task is now UNPLANNED and the case fails. This is a new time-dependent failure: roughly the hour before Bratislava sunrise, about 05:20-06:20 UTC in November. Fix: make the case d

Round 3, tree 1b7a8d3 (commit 5e724742d). The only change since the round-2 tree 717ba4b is in moon_separation_and_brightness (test_agent_scheduler.c:3127-3131): Fixed's limit is now ceil(separation + 16) instead of + 8, with an updated comment. The exact UNPLANNED 'too close to the moon' assertion stays. The limit is at most 86, within the parser range. Lorentzian is unchanged and still passes at once, because its separation fmin(limit + 8, 70) always exceeds its own Lorentzian limit.

Verification: the 2027-2028 geometry simulation with ceil(separation + 16), the same formula and placement as the test code, gave 0 of 16825 hourly samples where Fixed is planned (235 with + 8). Beside, Never and Lorentzian gave no failures either. make -C indigo_test test-agent-scheduler: 200 run, 200 passed.

The round-1 and round-2 findings are resolved. No remaining defects in scope.

Out of scope, pre-existing, for the owner:
- run_scheduler_simulators.py:477 expects South WAITING, but the target is UNREACHABLE at latitude 48.15 (already so on master).
- visibility_due_run_starts_after_a_run fails intermittently, as recorded in archived ticket 1dc2b4a0.

The server acceptance suites were not run.

history.text: Owner addition: the NOT TONIGHT information moves to the task list. AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASKS shall show the state NOT TONIGHT (instead of QUEUED/WAITING/RETRY/REPEAT) for an enabled, reachable task without script error that is not running and has no planned run before the end of the night, as determined by the latest update_plan(). The flag is recomputed at every plan update and the task list is republished when it changes. UNREACHABLE, DISABLED and SCRIPT ERROR keep their current task-list states. The plan itself lists only planned runs. Document the new task-list state in SCHEDULER.md and cover it in test_agent_scheduler.c (set when the task cannot fit tonight, cleared when it becomes plannable, not shown for hooks/running/terminal tasks).

Owner decision (supersedes the state name in the previous note): the task-list state is UNPLANNED, not NOT TONIGHT, because the plan can cover the coming night and the task may not fit the next night either. The task-list label of an UNPLANNED task carries the reason as an extra trailing column, using the reasons the plan gives today (from indigo_scheduler_points_next(), or 'no time left tonight' when the task could run but finds no room after the planned runs). Other states keep their current columns. The light of an UNPLANNED task is Idle (it is not an error). The NOT TONIGHT / UNREACHABLE plan rows and the no-night plan row are removed; the plan lists only planned runs. Update SCHEDULER.md, SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md and test_agent_scheduler.c accordingly.

Owner addition: the reason 'too bright (twilight)' (indigo_scheduler_sky_point_ok() in indigo_agent_scheduler_sky.c) is misleading, it is also given at midday. Replace it with the condition and the task setting, one static string per level: 'sun above -6° (@twilight civil)', 'sun above -12° (@twilight nautical)', 'sun above -18° (@twilight astronomical)'. Update every place that shows or documents the old text (SCHEDULER.md, SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md example, test_agent_scheduler.c assertions).

Owner decision (supersedes the wording in the previous note): no brackets. The twilight reason strings are 'sun above -6° for @twilight civil', 'sun above -12° for @twilight nautical' and 'sun above -18° for @twilight astronomical'. All other reason strings ('moon too bright', 'target below the altitude limit', ...) stay unchanged.

Owner decision (supersedes the wording in the previous notes): the twilight reason is simply 'sun above -6°', 'sun above -12°' or 'sun above -18°', depending on the task's @twilight limit (civil, nautical, astronomical). No mention of @twilight, no brackets.

Owner addition: the task-list label of an UNREACHABLE task (not a hook) also carries the reason as the extra trailing column, the same text as the 'Task NAME can never run: ...' message (task->unreachable), for example 'culminates at 15.3°, below the minimum altitude 20°'. The one-time message itself stays. Document in SCHEDULER.md and cover in test_agent_scheduler.c (reason present, updated when the reason changes, gone when the task becomes reachable).

Owner decision: every AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASKS label has the reason as a 7th column, so all rows keep the same format. Only UNPLANNED (plan reason) and UNREACHABLE (unreachable text) fill it; all other rows, hooks included, pass an empty column, which join_label() renders as '-'. Example: 'M31 | QUEUED | normal 50 | run 0/1 | retries left 2 | 0h45 measured | -'. Update SCHEDULER.md task-list format and every test that parses or compares task-list labels.

Scope addition found while checking consumers: also update indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md (task-list example near line 147, UNREACHABLE text near line 268, any NOT TONIGHT / too bright (twilight) / plan examples), and check the column-indexed parsers of task-list labels in indigo_test/integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py, run_scheduler_two_servers.py and tools/scheduler_sandbox.py still work with the 7th column.

Fix: make the case deterministic, e.g. set_site(0, longitude_at_hour(20)) before the upload.
2. The relaxed expectations make coverage depend on the time of the run, in cases where the outcome could be fixed. wait_task_waiting() (264) and waits_with_reason() (2840) accept WAITING or UNPLANNED, and accept UNPLANNED with any reason. So whenever the label is UNPLANNED, the underlying WAITING state (constraint not holding now) for each constraint type goes unchecked, and a wrong UNPLANNED flag or reason would pass. Two kinds of case:
   (a) Some cases are already deterministic and should assert the exact result. twilight_limit_follows_the_sun (3095) runs at local noon at the equator, so 'Night only' is always planned after dusk and is WAITING. unknown_site_blocks_only_sky_constraints (3205-3206, also 5961) has no sky, so 'Placed' and 'Dark only' are always UNPLANNED, and that should be asserted together with the reason.
   (b) The others depend on time only because of the fixed longitude 17.11 combined with time(NULL): target_below_horizon_waits (1263/1266), global_altitude_limits_decide_and_recover (2850/2872), hour_angle_ranges_including_wrapped (Low sides 3080/3085), nightly_windows (Gap 3178, Outside), moon (Fixed 3134). Use longitude_at_hour(H), as global_minimum_altitude_rules_out_the_night and start_with_crossing_task already do, and keep the exact WAITING (or exact UNPLANNED with its reason) assertions, so the tests stay deterministic as the tests rule requires.
   The wait_task_reachable() '°' heuristic (2935) is acceptable because Low and Polar both use @twilight none.

Not blocking: MAX_PLAN_ITEMS (indigo_agent_scheduler.c:66) still reserves MAX_TASKS items for the removed rows, which is harmless.
